page.layout: One page: digitiser's cover sheet. Top right e-rara logo; centred title block; below a rule, a notice block in two languages, rule, terms of use block; bottom right Visual Library logo. No printed book page text beyond the title block.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara.ch, Bibliothèque de Genève), not part of the printed book. Logos, portal notice, terms of use and links omitted as digitiser's material. Title information as shown on the cover: Symboli apostolici explicatio quatuor thesibus, earumque expositione partim ex Verbo Dei, partim ex patribus orthodoxis et contrariarum objectionum refutatione breviter comprehensa. Per Lambertum ... Author: Daneau, Lambert. Place and year: Genève, 1587. Shelf mark: Bc 23 = Bb 1277 (2).
